description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeMigrationJobs**接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data migration instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 数据迁移实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.zh: 查询数据迁移任务的状态
title.en: Query the status of a data migration task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-migration-job-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtsxxxxxxxx --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeMigrationJobStatus --region cn-hangzhou --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --MigrationJobId dtsxxxxxxxx
